title: Per-CELL census of heads 17, 19, 23 on BUTTON validation: does the depth localisation D36/PR-015 found on basket TRANSFER ACROSS CODEWORDS, and does the basket TRAIN screen predict the button cell? A TEST, with a p.
design_ref: S-309 (the axis amendment that unblocks button); S-306/S-307 (the basket result this tests); S-310 (the denominator collision this family's shape creates); S-311 (the bar as a frozen rule); AM-37/S-294 (why earlier cell families could not carry a p)
statistical_unit: DOMAIN for every E (23 domains, 230 rows, never the row). THE TEST UNIT IS THE HEAD: K admitted heads, one argmax each.
endpoint: y_install; concept-free semantic_one_word; cell C; n_examples 4

arms.BC_KO: --intervene with NO selector = all 32 heads x all 9 band layers; the denominator
arms.HD_<h>: --knockout-cells for ALL NINE band cells of head h. The whole-head arm: it supplies that head's bar (S-311 rule) and its ADMISSION, and it is the head-level cross-codeword replication of D34. NOT all three are new: HD_19 re-runs the head PR-CSI-013 already measured on button as its control arm BT_CTRL_01 (E = -0.035568), so it is a cross-JOB reproduction check rather than a first measurement. HD_17 and HD_23 have never had a button arm. EXCLUDED from the depth map and from every per-cell count.

SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.source: S-269's reading of the basket TRAIN AtP screen
SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.RE_DERIVED_BY_THIS_SCRIPT: yes -- argmax_L |AtP_by_cell[L,h]| over the 288-cell grid; a mismatch is a REFUSAL (R27 filed the un-pinned literal in the PR-015 freeze script as a MINOR)
SCREEN_PREDICTIONS_ON_RECORD_BEFORE_THIS.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: the screen is TRAIN and basket; the HEAD SET is basket VALIDATION (D34). The LAYER is held out on split AND codeword; the HEAD is not.

PRIMARY.statistic: M = number of ADMITTED heads whose argmax band layer by |E| equals that head's frozen screen-predicted layer
PRIMARY.null: H0: the screen's per-cell prediction is unrelated to the button depth profile, so each admitted head's argmax is uniform over the 9 band layers and independent across heads
PRIMARY.SUCCESS: p <= 0.05 AND the spanning rule below is satisfied

SPANNING_RULE.rule: the MATCHING heads must not all share one band layer
SPANNING_RULE.WHY: the screen predicts L14 for TWO of the three heads. If the button intervention carries a shared bias toward the top of the band, M=2 arrives for free and p=0.034 would read as a pass while measuring NOTHING about the screen. Frozen before any number exists.
SPANNING_RULE.IF_VIOLATED: CANNOT ANSWER on the screen question, whatever p says. The depth map is still reportable as a description.

PRIMARY.MUST_ALSO_BE_REPORTED: the full per-head argmax, the intervention's own argmax marginal across the admitted heads, and every dropped head with its power

ROBUSTNESS_CO_PRIMARIES_ADDED_BEFORE_LAU.WHY: the SPANNING RULE blocks the M=2 shared-bias pass and leaves M=3 OPEN. If the button intervention carries the top-of-band bias this design hypothesises, heads 17 and 19 are pinned to L14 FOR FREE and the only informative event is head 23 landing on L7 -- probability 1/9 = 0.1111, which cannot clear alpha. The binomial p would read 0.001372 and understate the type-I error of the SCIENTIFIC claim by ~81x. R28 demonstrated exactly that by building the biased world and running the real reader on it.
ROBUSTNESS_CO_PRIMARIES_ADDED_BEFORE_LAU.p_conditional: P(Binom(K_unique, 1/9) >= M_unique) over the ADMITTED heads whose screen-predicted layer is not shared with another admitted head. With 17 and 19 both predicted L14, K_unique = 1, floor 0.1111.
ROBUSTNESS_CO_PRIMARIES_ADDED_BEFORE_LAU.p_permutation: the exact permutation p over assignments of the screen's prediction MULTISET to the admitted heads. It asks whether the screen put the ODD prediction on the RIGHT head, which a shared band bias cannot fake because it says nothing about WHICH head gets the minority layer. With {L14, L14, L7} its floor is 1/3.
ROBUSTNESS_CO_PRIMARIES_ADDED_BEFORE_LAU.HOW_THE_CLAIM_MUST_BE_STATED: with the WEAKEST of the three, each named. A headline quoting only the binomial p is FORBIDDEN whenever two admitted heads share a predicted layer.
ROBUSTNESS_CO_PRIMARIES_ADDED_BEFORE_LAU.NOT_A_SUCCESS_CRITERION: these do NOT gate the preregistered PASS/FAIL, because requiring them would make this family unable to pass for a STRUCTURAL reason (K_unique = 1) rather than an empirical one. They BOUND THE WORDING -- which S-307 established is the honest use of a robustness number, except that these are frozen BEFORE the run, not after.

ADMISSION.rule: head h is ADMITTED iff its whole-head arm HD_<h> has a ci95 excluding 0 AND |E(HD_<h>)| >= 1.5 x bar(h)
ADMISSION.COMPUTED_FROM: the whole-head arm ALONE, never from the cells -- admitting on the cells would select the heads on the data the primary then reads
ADMISSION.A_DROPPED_HEAD_IS_NOT_A_MISS: it is removed from K and reported with its power. K falls and the floor rises; at K=1 the floor is 1/9 = 0.1111 and the family is CANNOT ANSWER.
ADMISSION.EXPECTED: head 19 is expected to be admitted (PR-013 measured |E|/bar = 5.69 there). Heads 17 and 23 have NEVER had a button arm and may fail this gate. That is the family's real risk and it is priced here, not hidden.

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.method: S-311: the bar is frozen as a RULE, not a number, because heads 17 and 23 have never had a button arm and no number for them can exist before the run

BAR_IS_A_RULE.rule: bar(h) = z * SD(per-domain paired delta of arm <bar_source_arm> minus the base arm) / sqrt(n_domains)
BAR_IS_A_RULE.WHY_NOT_A_NUMBER: heads 17 and 23 have no prior button arm. Head 19's bar IS predictable from PR-013 and is recorded as a falsifiable PREDICTION under per_head['19'], never as the bar used.
BAR_IS_A_RULE.VERIFIED: the identical rule, run against D34's SINGLE_17 arm, reproduces the 0.009082 that PR-CSI-015 froze as a NUMBER (tests/test_csi_cell_identity.py::test_the_bar_RULE_reproduces_the_NUMBER_that_PR015_froze)

head19_bar_prediction_from_pr013.STATUS: A FALSIFIABLE PREDICTION, NOT THE BAR. The bar used is computed by the S-311 rule from THIS family's own HD_19 arm. If the two disagree by more than 25% that is a finding about cross-job reproducibility and must be reported.

DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.⚠ NOT_HELD_OUT: each bar is computed from this family's own whole-head arm on the same 23 domains the cells are read on. It is a DIFFERENT ARM and only its SPREAD is used, never its mean, so it is not circular in the strong sense -- but it is NOT held out and must not be called so (S-307 §6 made the same point about PR-015's bars).
DETECTABILITY_PREREGISTERED_PER_HEAD.NOT_THE_PRIMARY: the primary is the argmax agreement, which needs no bar at all. The bars serve ADMISSION and the descriptive depth map only.

DOSE_EXPECTATION.STATUS: MEASURED (PR-CSI-014 observed exactly 224.0 on nine cells across nine layers, S-299; PR-CSI-015 reproduced it on 27 more, S-306)
DOSE_EXPECTATION.⚠ BLIND_AS_AN_IDENTITY: all 27 cell arms expect 224 and all three HD_ arms expect 2016 -- the SAME dose as BC_KO. Identity comes from each arm's own knockout_cells ONLY (S-310).

population.TEST_DOMAIN_COUNT_CORRECTED: PR-CSI-014's and PR-CSI-015's preregs both record test_domains = 3, and S-294's axis inventory rests on it ('the 3 TEST domains need n > 3.8'). The frozen manifest dcs_ts116_domain_split.json declares n_test = 23, and BOTH banks carry 4416 rows over 23 distinct TEST domains -- identical to validation. See S-312. TEST is NOT touched here.
population.SAME_DOMAINS_AS_BASKET: S-256 verified the 23 validation domains are the same set. This family therefore controls the CODEWORD, not the domain sample.

CANNOT_ANSWER_IF: fewer than 2 heads are ADMITTED (at K=1 the floor 1/9 = 0.1111 cannot clear alpha=0.05)
the spanning rule is violated -- the matching heads all share one band layer
any admitted head's nine cells contain a tie for the argmax
VOID_CONDITIONS: 3. any TEST domain in any arm
5. an arm whose recorded knockout_cells != this prereg's cell_sets entry for it
6. score_behavior.py or src/ edited while these arms are in flight
7. any single-cell arm recording a dose other than 224, or any HD_ arm other than 2016
8. BC_KO recording a non-empty knockout_cells (S-310: a 9-cell arm is dose-identical and identity-identical to it on knockout_heads)
9. the read amended after any number is seen
NO_RANK_TEST: There is no candidate cell, no control family of arbitrary cells and no rank here. The PRIMARY is a per-head ARGMAX agreement against a prediction frozen on a different split AND a different codeword, tested as Binom(K, 1/9). control_prefix and n_controls are DELIBERATELY ABSENT so the rank tooling refuses this prereg.
CENSUS_DELIVERABLE: 27 single-cell effects E(BC_H<h>_L<ll>) = mean over domains of (y_install(cell) - y_install(BC_BASE)), each with a bootstrap ci95; three whole-head arms HD_<h> that supply the bars and the ADMISSION and are EXCLUDED from every per-cell count; and the BC_KO denominator.
SELECTION_RE_ENTERS_WHEN: any single cell is named as 'the' site. The PRIMARY tests a PREDICTION made before the data existed, which is why it can carry a p; naming a winner afterwards is selection on the data that produced it, and AM-37 still holds that no admissible held-out axis exists for THAT test.
DOSE_IDENTITY_IS_BLIND_HERE: all 27 single-cell arms expect 224, and the three HD_ arms expect 2016 -- the SAME dose as BC_KO. The dose cannot tell any cell from any other, nor a whole-head arm from the denominator. Identity comes from each arm's own knockout_cells ONLY (S-292/S-310).
WHAT_THIS_CANNOT_ANSWER: whether any cell is PRIVILEGED among ARBITRARY cells -- there is no control family of arbitrary cells anywhere in this sprint
whether the depth localisation generalises beyond these three heads, which were selected as load-bearing on basket VALIDATION and are NOT held out
whether per-cell effects ADD -- PR-CSI-012's prereg listed this as unanswerable and S-307 measured the departure without resolving it
anything about the other 29 heads, about DOMAIN generality, or about the 3 TEST domains
anything behavioural: y_install is a semantic readout, not a refusal endpoint
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_POSITIVE: the binomial p ALONE whenever two admitted heads share a predicted layer -- the conditional and permutation p's must be quoted beside it and the claim stated with the weakest (R28/S-312)
that cell (L,h) is 'the writer' -- this tests the SCREEN's prediction, not a cell's privilege among arbitrary cells; there is still no control family of arbitrary cells

that the screen is a validated cell selector IN GENERAL -- at most this makes the intervention-verified sample 3 more heads, on a second codeword, and all of them were selected as load-bearing on basket VALIDATION
anything about the other 29 heads, or about DOMAIN generality, or about TEST
MUST_NOT_BE_SAID_IF_NULL: that the basket result is withdrawn -- a failure to transfer across codewords is a statement about TRANSFER, and S-306/S-307 stand on their own data
that the screen is useless -- a null here bounds it to the codeword it was computed on
'underpowered' without quoting K, the dropped heads and their measured power
